name: Reaction Profiles for [3+2] Cycloadditions
description: Bio-orthogonal click chemistry based on [3 + 2] dipolar cycloadditions has had a profound impact on the field of biochemistry and significant effort has been devoted to identify promising new candidate reactions for this purpose. To gauge whether a prospective reaction could be a suitable bio-orthogonal click reaction, information about both on- and off-target activation and reaction energies is highly valuable. Here, we use an automated workflow, based on the autodE program, to compute over 5000 reaction profiles for [3 + 2] cycloadditions involving both synthetic dipolarophiles and a set of biologically-inspired structural motifs. Based on a succinct benchmarking study, the B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-TZVP//B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP level of theory was selected for the DFT calculations, and standard conditions and an (aqueous) SMD model were imposed to mimic physiological conditions. reputation: A specialized computational chemistry dataset/workflow paper rather than a widely used public benchmark, but relevant for reaction energetics and bio-orthogonal chemistry research.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark based on DFT-computed reaction profiles; useful for method comparison but not a standard leaderboard benchmark.
